summary: Confirmed fees 36-46, 50A FHU. Changed sites 96->150 ('nearly 150'); season now 05-01..10-15; added facilities and Firefly booking. Note cleaned.
flags: GATE: posted 2026 page $36 30A W/E (also dry $36), 50A W/E $42, 50A FHU $46, plus 9% tax and a one-time $3.50 booking fee, under $50. Page carries a ©2024 footer but a map dated April 2026. RV Life 2026 reviewers paid $44-53 ($80 in one Good Sam 7/2026 entry unexplained). Firefly form loads with Motorhome and RV-manufacture-year fields; I did not run a dated search, as the season is closed.
RATINGS: Google 4.5 (165); RV Life 4 stars (25); Campendium 5.0 (5); The Dyrt not found under the slug tried; Campspot not listed. None under 4.0 with 25+.

LONG-STAY, not a drop as read: the page says 'only a limited number of short-stay sites' and sells long-term stays; Google review: 'This is a seasonal RV trailer park'; RV Life: 'Older campground with lots of seasonal sites'. No seasonal count, so test 4 passes by default; nights are for sale online at a posted rate.

WATERFRONT 'lakefront' stands on the April 2026 map: sites 509-521 back straight onto the lake with Bald Eagle Loop behind them, and imagery shows rigs along that shore. But sites are sold by type, not number, and those shore sites may be seasonal. RV Life reviewers (2026) report 'beautiful site overlooking lake' and 'back in full hook up overlooking lake'; others were on 101/102 at the entry. Nothing says a nightly guest can get one beyond the $5 lock by phone.
ACCESS: RV Life review: 'It is a long dirt bumpy road to the campground! Our Class A did not like it!' No operator statement; nothing here suggests 4WD.
PHONE: stored 207-952-4279 matches Google. An RV Life reviewer gives 207-952-4270 as new; not confirmed. Operator's contact page URL guesses returned 404.
Pin fine: on the office/lawn area within the campground on imagery.
